phases.label: Phase 1
phases.name: Dashboard Shell
phases.description: The live discovery shell at app.minepanel.xyz: a static, installable React PWA that connects the browser directly to operator-selected self-hosted backends.

items.text: Deploy to app.minepanel.xyz via Cloudflare Pages
Multi-backend instance registry (IndexedDB, local metadata only)
Strict origin validation (public HTTPS DNS only; rejects IPs, localhost, .local)
Backend probe via public GET /api/info (name & version)
Installable PWA with same-origin app-shell caching
Security headers, strict CSP and SPA fallback on Cloudflare Pages
Unit tests for origin validation, instance registry and backend client

phases.label: Phase 1.5
phases.name: Hosted Authentication
phases.description: The supported protocol-1 hosted-auth contract is complete: CHIPS partitioned HttpOnly cookies + Web Locks for hosted sessions, with local auth, Google auth, TOTP, account security, and first-admin setup. CHIPS/Web Locks are not universal across browsers.

items.text: Capability discovery from /api/info
Local login, registration, and PENDING-account handling
Session restore with single-flight refresh and cross-tab/session termination
TOTP challenge, enrollment, backup codes, and disable
Google OAuth login and authenticated account linking
Password change and session management
First-admin setup

phases.label: Phase 2
phases.name: Dashboard Management
phases.description: Authenticated server management surface: lifecycle controls, access control, admin user management, MOD permission grants, and ADMIN host metrics over cookie-authenticated WebSocket telemetry.

items.text: Server list and lifecycle controls (create, start, stop, restart, delete)
Host metrics (CPU, RAM, disk) via cookie-authenticated WebSocket
Role-aware interface (ADMIN / MOD / USER, per-server permissions)
Access requests and approval flows (OPEN / REQUEST / PRIVATE) with requestable-server discovery
Admin user management and approval flows
MOD permission grants (global and per-server)

phases.label: Phase 3
phases.name: Operations
phases.description: Player management, real-time console, backups, scheduled tasks, notifications, file manager, and plugin/mod management as the backend Phase 3 API lands.

items.text: Real-time console and server event stream
Backups and scheduled tasks
Notifications
File manager
Player management
Plugin and mod management

futureWork.text: Conditional PKCE compatibility fallback if supported-browser requirements expand; not required for the current policy and not implemented

scope: scope: MinePanel hosted dashboard (minepanel-pwa). This file is the PWA roadmap; it does not redefine the global backend project roadmap.
